name: Qinxin Lianqu/Xiedu Shenming De Shaonü
original_name: 欺心恋曲/亵渎神明的少女
source:
You will step into the shoes of the protagonist "Zilin SAI", gradually unraveling the mysteries of "Heart City" Morodo, meeting a diverse cast of characters, encountering your destined "her", and embarking on a unique romantic story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3980000/_Deceptiive_Love_Ballad_The_Blasphemer]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演主角梓傾賽，一步步揭開「心城」莫羅多的謎團，結識形形色色的人，遇見命中註定的那個「她」，展開一段與眾不同的戀愛故事。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3980000/_Deceptiive_Love_Ballad_The_Blasphemer]Steam[/url]］
